integrity: Finite computations are proved with exact arithmetic and independently checked rooted Laplacians plus a separate weighted spectral determinant. The classical theorem relating component groups to graph Jacobians is invoked with the specified hypotheses. Independent external validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact graph group for the full normal-crossings divisor on the blowup of the 49 singular points of the Klein 21-line arrangement over the complex numbers. The Néron interpretation is only for proper regular semistable one-parameter smoothings with all node thicknesses one. It is not a classification of the blown-up surface Picard group, nonsplit residue fields, or nonunit-thickness models. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: The integral Néron component group of the stable Klein 21-line boundary
